blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】サブクエスト
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Subquests

blocks.source: サブクエストとは、ゲームの本編（メインクエスト）とは別に攻略が必須ではない寄り道イベントのことである。
blocks.translation: A subquest is an optional side event separate from the main story (main quest) of a game.

blocks.source: 昨今のＲＰＧでは、大手メーカーの大作からインディーゲームまでサブクエストが当たり前のように存在している。
blocks.translation: In today's RPGs, subquests are commonplace, from major titles by large manufacturers to indie games.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣの時代にはいくつかの寄り道要素がある程度の作品が大半だったが、今となってはサブクエスト制を採用していない作品のほうが珍しいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: During the SFC era, most games had only a few side activities, but these days, games that do not use a subquest system may be the rare ones.

blocks.source: そんなサブクエストについて、一度考察してみたい。
blocks.translation: I would like to take a closer look at subquests.

blocks.source: ここではサブクエストという呼称を使うが、寄り道要素全般を扱う。
blocks.translation: I will use the term "subquest" here, but this discussion covers side activities in general.

blocks.source: なお、以下の『自由度』に関する講座と内容は多少かぶっている。
blocks.translation: The content also overlaps somewhat with the following guide on "Freedom of Choice."

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/377351764.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/377351764.html

blocks.source: 目次
blocks.translation: Table of Contents

blocks.source: サブクエストの種類
blocks.translation: Types of Subquests

blocks.source: まずはサブクエストの種類を挙げてみたい。
blocks.translation: First, I would like to list some types of subquests.

blocks.source: どのようなサブクエストを採用するかによって、作品の雰囲気も変わってくるはずだ。
blocks.translation: The atmosphere of a game should also change depending on the types of subquests it adopts.

blocks.source: 標準型
blocks.translation: Standard Type

blocks.source: メインクエストとほぼ変わらない品質のイベント。
blocks.translation: An event with quality almost on par with the main quest.

blocks.source: 導入から結末まで短編としてのストーリー性があるため、最も手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Because it has the story structure of a short story from beginning to end, it requires the most effort.

blocks.source: 個人的にはアークザラッド２が印象深い。
blocks.translation: Personally, I remember Arc the Lad II particularly well.

blocks.source: 賞金首型
blocks.translation: Bounty Type

blocks.source: ボスを倒すことを目的としたイベント。
blocks.translation: An event whose objective is to defeat a boss.

blocks.source: 基本的にストーリー性はほぼなく、ボス戦のみとなる。
blocks.translation: It generally has little to no story and consists only of a boss battle.

blocks.source: ボス戦までの流れを凝ったものにした場合は、標準型と変わらなくなる。
blocks.translation: If the events leading up to the boss battle are elaborate, it becomes no different from the standard type.

blocks.source: メタルマックスシリーズやＦＦシリーズなど数多くの作品で見かける。
blocks.translation: This type can be found in many games, including the Metal Max and Final Fantasy series.

blocks.source: 簡略型
blocks.translation: Simplified Type

blocks.source: 標準型を大幅に簡略したもの。
blocks.translation: A heavily simplified version of the standard type.

blocks.source: 依頼文と報告以外はほぼストーリー性がない。
blocks.translation: Other than the request and the report, it has almost no story.

blocks.source: 「スライムを１０体倒せ」「薬草を５個持ってこい」のような内容が多く、いかにもなお使いイベントである。
blocks.translation: The objectives are often things like "Defeat 10 slimes" or "Bring me 5 medicinal herbs," making them quintessential fetch quests.

blocks.source: 依頼文の内容を頑張れば申し訳程度にストーリー性を出すこともできるが、さすがにこれだけで面白くするには限界があるだろう。
blocks.translation: Working hard on the request's wording can add a modest amount of story, but there are limits to how interesting this alone can be.

blocks.source: 自動生成型
blocks.translation: Automatically Generated Type

blocks.source: 内容的には簡略型に近いが、さらに内容をランダム生成したもの。
blocks.translation: Similar in content to the simplified type, but with the content generated randomly as well.

blocks.source: クリアしても終わらず、無限に引受けできる場合もある。
blocks.translation: It may not end even after completion, allowing the player to accept quests indefinitely.

blocks.source: ＡＩの発展に伴い、将来的にはもっと複雑なイベントが自動生成されるようになるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: As AI advances, increasingly complex events may be generated automatically in the future.

blocks.source: 派遣型
blocks.translation: Dispatch Type

blocks.source: 戦闘に参加しないメンバーを派遣するイベント。
blocks.translation: An event in which members who do not participate in battle are dispatched.

blocks.source: ＦＦＴの儲け話やゼノブレイド２の傭兵団任務など。
blocks.translation: Examples include FFT's propositions and the mercenary organization missions in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.

blocks.source: 一度派遣した後は、時間経過（日数経過、プレイ時間など）を待つだけで操作をすることはない。つまり放置型である。
blocks.translation: After dispatching them once, you simply wait for time to pass (days, play time, and so on), without taking any further action. In other words, it is an idle type.

blocks.source: 内容そのものは簡略型のような単純なものであることが多い。
blocks.translation: The content itself is often simple, like that of the simplified type.

blocks.source: サブクエストの開始方法
blocks.translation: Ways to Start a Subquest

blocks.source: サブクエストはその開始方法によっても個性付けができる。
blocks.translation: Subquests can also be given distinctive character through the way they are started.

blocks.source: 作品内で統一するか、場合によって異なる開始方法を取ってもよい。
blocks.translation: You can standardize the method throughout the game, or use different methods depending on the situation.

blocks.source: 施設で受注
blocks.translation: Accepting Quests at a Facility

blocks.source: ギルドなどサブクエスト用の施設で受注する。
blocks.translation: The player accepts quests at a facility for subquests, such as a guild.

blocks.source: 開始方法が分かりやすく、見落としが発生しにくいのが利点だろう。
blocks.translation: The advantage is that the way to start them is easy to understand, making them less likely to be overlooked.

blocks.source: 依頼者から受注
blocks.translation: Accepting Quests from the Requester

blocks.source: 町の住民など依頼者から直接受注する。
blocks.translation: The player accepts quests directly from requesters, such as town residents.

blocks.source: 依頼者を誰にするかによっても個性づけができる。
blocks.translation: The requester can also give the quest a distinctive character.

blocks.source: 突発的に発生
blocks.translation: Arising Unexpectedly

blocks.source: 必ずしも依頼という形式を取る必要はない。
blocks.translation: A quest does not necessarily have to take the form of a request.

blocks.source: 例えば、落とし穴から洞窟内に落下した後で「洞窟から脱出しよう」というようなクエストを発生させてもよい。
blocks.translation: For example, after the player falls through a pitfall into a cave, you could trigger a quest such as "Let's escape from the cave."

blocks.source: メインクエストから派生
blocks.translation: Branching Off from the Main Quest

blocks.source: メインクエストの最中にサブクエストを発生させてもよい。
blocks.translation: A subquest can arise during the main quest.

blocks.source: 例えば「ボスを倒すにはとある武器が有効だが、別になくても倒せる」というように必須ではないクエストを発生させるなどだ。
blocks.translation: For example, you could create an optional quest where "a certain weapon is effective against the boss, but the boss can still be defeated without it."

blocks.source: 他にも、取り逃した敵キャラの行方を追う寄り道クエストなんていうのはどうだろうか。
blocks.translation: Another possibility would be a side quest to track down an enemy the player missed.

blocks.source: サブクエストの利点
blocks.translation: Advantages of Side Quests

blocks.source: ゲーム制作者はどのような狙いでサブクエストを制作するのか？ 利点を考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: What goals do game developers have when creating side quests? Let’s consider their advantages.

blocks.source: 攻略自由度の増加
blocks.translation: Greater Freedom in How to Progress

blocks.source: サブクエストは進行するタイミングなどの自由度が高い。
blocks.translation: Side quests offer considerable freedom in when and how to progress through them.

blocks.source: それによって、ゲーム性を向上させる効果がある。
blocks.translation: This can improve the gameplay experience.

blocks.source: 例えば、あるクエストで手に入れた武器が、別のクエストのボスの弱点だったりすれば、攻略を工夫する余地が生まれる。
blocks.translation: For example, if a weapon obtained from one quest is the weakness of a boss in another quest, players have room to devise their own strategies.

blocks.source: 任意性
blocks.translation: Optionality

blocks.source: プレイヤーはサブクエストのやるやらないを選択することができる。
blocks.translation: Players can choose whether or not to take on side quests.

blocks.source: つまり「面倒ならやらなければいい」というわけだ。
blocks.translation: In other words, “if it seems like a hassle, you don’t have to do it.”

blocks.source: 重要でないクエストをサブに回すことで、プレイヤーは理想のテンポでゲームを進めることができる。
blocks.translation: By making less important quests optional, players can progress through the game at their ideal pace.

blocks.source: ストーリーの補完
blocks.translation: Filling Out the Story

blocks.source: サブクエストを活用すれば、メインクエストでは描ききれなかった部分を補完できる。
blocks.translation: Side quests can be used to fill in parts that could not be fully depicted in the main quests.

blocks.source: プレイヤーに強制するほどではないイベントは、サブクエストとして実装すればよいだろう。
blocks.translation: Events that are not important enough to force on the player can be implemented as side quests.

blocks.source: 経験値稼ぎの代替
blocks.translation: An Alternative to Grinding for Experience

blocks.source: 古典的な経験値稼ぎの代わりの手段として、サブクエストを活用する方法。
blocks.translation: Side quests can serve as an alternative to the classic method of grinding for experience.

blocks.source: 経験値稼ぎは同じことの繰り返しになりやすく、飽きられやすい。サブクエストという形式を取れば、そういった単調さを緩和できる。
blocks.translation: Grinding for experience tends to involve repeating the same actions and can quickly become tiresome. Using side quests can alleviate that monotony.

blocks.source: 『簡略型』や『自動生成型』と組み合わせるのもよいかもしれない。
blocks.translation: It may also be a good idea to combine them with simplified or procedurally generated content.

blocks.source: 内容の水増し
blocks.translation: Padding Out the Content

blocks.source: 本編だけだとすぐに終わってしまって物足りない――なんて作品はサブクエストによって内容を水増しすることができる。
blocks.translation: If a game feels too short and unsatisfying when played with only the main story, side quests can be used to pad out its content.

blocks.source: 本編に継ぎ足すよりは、独立したプロットでイベントを作成できるため、比較的に作りやすいという利点はある。
blocks.translation: Unlike adding to the main story, events can be created from independent plots, which has the advantage of making them relatively easy to develop.

blocks.source: 奥深いシステムや豊富なスキルを作ったのに、それを活かすだけの本編の規模がない――なんていう場合は使えるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: They may be useful when you have created deep systems and a wealth of skills, but the main story is not large enough to make full use of them.

blocks.source: なお、水増しという言葉は一般的にネガティブな意味で使われることが多い。当然、デメリットもあるので後述する。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the term “padding” is generally used in a negative sense. Naturally, there are disadvantages as well, which I will discuss later.

blocks.source: サブクエストの欠点
blocks.translation: Disadvantages of Side Quests

blocks.source: サブクエストにはそれなりに大きな欠点がある。
blocks.translation: Side quests have some fairly significant disadvantages.

blocks.source: そのため、流行だからといって思考停止で導入することはオススメしない。
blocks.translation: For that reason, I do not recommend adding them thoughtlessly just because they are popular.

blocks.source: 以下に欠点をまとめてみた。
blocks.translation: I have summarized their disadvantages below.

blocks.source: メインストーリーとの相性
blocks.translation: Compatibility with the Main Story

blocks.source: 当然ながら、メインストーリーに切迫感がある作品と寄り道要素は相性が悪い。
blocks.translation: Naturally, detours do not work well in games whose main stories have a strong sense of urgency.

blocks.source: 「人質の命が危ない、一刻も早く助けないと！」とか「このままではあと二週間で世界が崩壊してしまう！」とか「ヒロインの余命はあと一ヶ月！」みたいな状況で寄り道三昧をしていたら、違和感が半端ない。
blocks.translation: If the situation is something like “The hostage’s life is in danger—we have to rescue them as soon as possible!”, “The world will collapse in two weeks if this continues!”, or “The heroine has only one month left to live!”, then spending all your time on detours creates an overwhelming sense of incongruity.

blocks.source: こういった設定をせざるを得ないにしても、明確かつ短い期間は出さないほうが無難だろう。
blocks.translation: Even if you have no choice but to establish this kind of premise, it is probably safer not to specify a clear, short time limit.

blocks.source: メインストーリーのテンポ悪化
blocks.translation: Disrupting the Main Story’s Pace

blocks.source: メインストーリーでグイグイ引っ張るタイプの作品は、サブクエストと相性が悪い。
blocks.translation: Games that strongly drive the player forward through their main stories do not pair well with side quests.

blocks.source: 「次の展開を見たい！」とプレイヤーに強く思わせても、それをサブクエストが挟まることによって腰を折ってしまうためだ。
blocks.translation: Even if players are eager to see what happens next, inserting side quests can completely disrupt that momentum.

blocks.source: １～２時間かけてサブクエストをやっているうちに、熱が冷めてしまったり、話を忘れてしまったなんてこともあるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: After spending one or two hours on side quests, players may lose interest or even forget what was happening in the story.

blocks.source: これは非常に大きな欠点であり、決して無視はできない。
blocks.translation: This is a very significant disadvantage and cannot be ignored.

blocks.source: ならば、「面倒ならやらなければいい」と思うかもしれないが、これもそう簡単な話ではない。
blocks.translation: You might think, “If it seems like a hassle, just don’t do it,” but the matter is not that simple.

blocks.source: 面倒ならやらなければいいの問題点
blocks.translation: The Problem with “If It Seems Like a Hassle, Just Don’t Do It”

blocks.source: サブクエストの利点として任意性――つまり「面倒ならやらなければいい」ということを前述した。しかし、これは常に通じるわけではない。
blocks.translation: I previously mentioned optionality as an advantage of side quests—in other words, “if it seems like a hassle, you don’t have to do it.” However, this does not always hold true.

blocks.source: というのも、プレイヤーにとって要不要を判断するのは、それなりに難しいことだからだ。
blocks.translation: That is because it is fairly difficult for players to determine whether something is necessary or not.

blocks.source: サブクエストをやらなかった結果、プレイヤーは強力な装備が手に入らず不利になるかもしれないし、面白いイベントを見逃すかもしれない。最悪、エンディング分岐に影響するかもしれない。
blocks.translation: If players skip side quests, they may be put at a disadvantage by missing out on powerful equipment, or they may miss interesting events. In the worst case, it could even affect the ending they receive.

blocks.source: そういった不利益を嫌うならば、プレイヤーは多少つまらなそうなサブクエストでも我慢してやらざるを得なくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: If players want to avoid such disadvantages, they may end up having to force themselves to complete side quests that seem somewhat boring.

blocks.source: そもそも、サブクエストがつまらないかどうかはやってみなければ分からないものだ。
blocks.translation: After all, you cannot know whether a side quest is boring without trying it.

blocks.source: 結果、サブクエストの存在によって、作品全体の評価が下がったりしては目も当てられない。
blocks.translation: It would be disastrous if the existence of side quests caused the overall evaluation of the game to decline.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、質より量を優先してサブクエストで内容を水増しすることは、個人的には否定的に考えている。
blocks.translation: For these reasons, I personally take a negative view of padding out content with side quests by prioritizing quantity over quality.

blocks.source: クリア率の低下
blocks.translation: Lower Completion Rates

blocks.source: サブクエストでゲーム内容を水増しすると、ゲームの質が下がると同時にクリアまでの時間は伸びていく。
blocks.translation: When side quests are used to pad out a game, the game’s quality declines while the time required to complete it increases.

blocks.source: そして、プレイヤーのクリア率は下がっていく。
blocks.translation: As a result, the player completion rate declines.

blocks.source: ＰＳやSteamのトロフィー（実績）機能を見れば分かりやすいけれど、ゲームのクリア率というものはプレイ時間に比例して如実に下がっていく。
blocks.translation: This is easy to see from the trophy (achievement) features on PlayStation and Steam, but completion rates clearly decline in proportion to playtime.

blocks.source: これは「一見して難易度が低く誰でもクリアできそうな作品」でも例外ではない。何十時間もゲームをプレイするという作業は、かなりの根気を要するものなのだ。
blocks.translation: This is no exception even for games that seem easy at first glance and appear completable by anyone. Playing a game for dozens of hours requires considerable perseverance.

blocks.source: 参考
blocks.translation: References

blocks.source: 【コラム】市販ＲＰＧのクリア率
blocks.translation: [Column] Completion Rates for Commercial RPGs

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/445846101.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/445846101.html

blocks.source: あくまで、筆者の経験則になるが「クリアできたけど短くて物足りなかったゲーム」と「長さにうんざりしてクリアできなかったゲーム」なら、後者のほうが印象が悪いように思う。
blocks.translation: This is based solely on my own experience, but between “a game I finished but found too short and unsatisfying” and “a game I couldn’t finish because I grew tired of its length,” I feel the latter leaves a worse impression.

blocks.source: そして、長ったるい作品は時間を無駄にしたと感じるため、次回作があったとしても手を出さなくなる。
blocks.translation: Also, because overly long games make you feel that you wasted your time, you may lose interest in playing their sequels, even if they exist.

blocks.source: 特にストーリーのつながった続編にとっては致命的だ。クリアを諦めたＲＰＧの続編に手を出す人なんて、相当な物好きぐらいだろう。
blocks.translation: This is particularly fatal for sequels with a connected story. Very few people would play the sequel to an RPG they gave up on finishing, except perhaps the most devoted fans.

blocks.source: 続編に限らず長期的な商業展開を考える場合、ユーザの信頼を得るためにも過度の水増しは避けるべきではないだろうか。
blocks.translation: When considering a long-term commercial release, not limited to sequels, shouldn’t excessive padding be avoided in order to earn the users’ trust?

blocks.source: バランス調整の複雑化
blocks.translation: The Increasing Complexity of Balance Adjustments

blocks.source: サブクエストをこなすかどうかによって、プレイヤーの強さは変化する。サブクエストの報酬をしっかり用意すればするほど強さの変化は大きくなる。
blocks.translation: The player’s strength changes depending on whether they complete side quests. The more substantial the side-quest rewards, the greater the change in strength.

blocks.source: 結果、想定する難易度の範囲は一本道のＲＰＧより広くなってしまう。
blocks.translation: As a result, the anticipated difficulty range becomes broader than that of a linear RPG.

blocks.source: 寄り道をたくさんしたプレイヤーにとっては簡単なボス戦も、メインクエストだけを一直線に進んできたプレイヤーにとっては難関かもしれない。
blocks.translation: A boss battle that is easy for a player who took many detours may be a formidable challenge for someone who advanced straight through only the main quests.

blocks.source: サブクエストをプレイヤーが一切やらない前提で調整するにしても、ある程度のクリアを前提とするにしても、誰もが満足する難易度設定は難しいだろう。
blocks.translation: Whether you balance the game on the assumption that players will not do any side quests at all or that they will complete a certain number of them, it will be difficult to set a difficulty level that satisfies everyone.

blocks.source: サブクエストを面白くする方法
blocks.translation: How to Make Side Quests Interesting

blocks.source: 結局のところ、サブクエストがプレイヤーを夢中にさせるほどに面白ければ、全ては許される。
blocks.translation: Ultimately, if side quests are interesting enough to engross players, everything else can be forgiven.

blocks.source: というわけで、サブクエストを面白くする方法を考えてみたい。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, I would like to consider ways to make side quests interesting.

blocks.source: 通常のイベントを面白くする方法については、過去に以下の記事を書いたので、こちらも参考にして頂きたい。サブクエストだろうが、メインクエストだろうが基本は同じである。
blocks.translation: I previously wrote the following article about how to make ordinary events interesting, so I hope you will refer to it as well. The basics are the same whether it is a side quest or a main quest.

blocks.source: 参考
blocks.translation: References

blocks.source: 面白いイベントを作るには？
blocks.translation: How Can You Create Interesting Events?

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/281558360.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/281558360.html

blocks.source: 例によって、無理に全てを採用する必要はないので、取捨選択をして欲しい。
blocks.translation: As usual, you do not need to adopt everything indiscriminately, so I encourage you to choose what works best.

blocks.source: 本編との接続
blocks.translation: Connecting to the Main Story

blocks.source: サブクエストの利点として『ストーリーの補完』を挙げた通り、サブクエストは本編とも積極的に絡めていきたい。
blocks.translation: As I mentioned when discussing “supplementing the story” as an advantage of side quests, I would like to actively tie side quests into the main story as well.

blocks.source: 例えば、主人公や仲間を初めとして、本編で登場したキャラクターを掘り下げるようなイベントを作成してみよう。
blocks.translation: For example, try creating events that delve deeper into characters who appeared in the main story, including the protagonist and their companions.

blocks.source: ポッと出のモブキャラに頼まれたお使いイベントを面白くすることは難しいので、積極的にキャラクターの魅力に頼っていきたい。
blocks.translation: It is difficult to make a fetch quest requested by a newly introduced minor character interesting, so I would like to rely actively on the appeal of established characters.

blocks.source: そういった意味では、サブクエストはいわゆるキャラゲーにも向いている。
blocks.translation: In that sense, side quests are also well suited to so-called character-driven games.

blocks.source: 具体的には……
blocks.translation: Specifically…

blocks.source: 仲間の掘り下げイベント。
blocks.translation: Events that delve deeper into the companions.

blocks.source: 本編では出番に恵まれなかったサブキャラのその後。
blocks.translation: What happens afterward to a supporting character who did not get much time in the main story.

blocks.source: 本編では中途半端になっていた敵キャラのその後。
blocks.translation: What happens afterward to an enemy who was left unresolved in the main story.

blocks.source: のようなイベントが考えられる。
blocks.translation: Events such as these could be considered.

blocks.source: 仲間の掘り下げイベントを仲間の最強装備の入手イベントにしてしまうのも良い方法だ。ご褒美にもなるので、ゲームを大いに盛り上げてくれるだろう。
blocks.translation: Another good approach is to make an event that delves deeper into a companion also serve as an event for obtaining their ultimate equipment. Since it also serves as a reward, it will likely add considerable excitement to the game.

blocks.source: 連作短編
blocks.translation: A Series of Connected Short Stories

blocks.source: サブクエストをクリアしたら、さらなる関連クエストを発生させてみよう。
blocks.translation: After completing a side quest, try triggering another related quest.

blocks.source: 同じ依頼主によるクエストを連続させてもよいし、全く予想できないような派生をしても面白い。
blocks.translation: You could continue with quests from the same client, or take the story in a completely unexpected direction.

blocks.source: 例えば、ある町で良かれとやったクエストが、別の町では災いの原因になってしまう――なんていうのはどうだろうか。
blocks.translation: For example, how about having a quest undertaken with good intentions in one town become the cause of a disaster in another?

blocks.source: このようにすれば、複数のクエストによって単なる短編には留まらない大がかりなストーリーも描くことができる。
blocks.translation: In this way, multiple quests can be used to tell a large-scale story that goes beyond being merely a short episode.

blocks.source: 依頼主などの登場人物を印象づけやすいことも利点となるだろう。
blocks.translation: Another advantage is that it becomes easier to make characters such as the clients memorable.

blocks.source: コミカル
blocks.translation: Comedy

blocks.source: サブクエストはコミカルなイベントにも向いている。本編ではできないような馬鹿馬鹿しいイベントを作ってみよう。
blocks.translation: Side quests are also well suited to comedic events. Try creating some silly events that would not fit into the main story.

blocks.source: もちろん、仲間との楽しい会話も忘れずに。
blocks.translation: Of course, do not forget to include fun conversations with the companions.

blocks.source: 意外な導入
blocks.translation: An Unexpected Introduction

blocks.source: 最もありきたりなサブクエストの形式は、誰か（特にギルドなど）から依頼を受けるようなものだろう。
blocks.translation: The most commonplace type of side quest is probably one in which you receive a request from someone, especially a guild.

blocks.source: そこでそのありきたりを裏切ってみよう。
blocks.translation: So try defying that convention.

blocks.source: 例えば、冒険の途中で唐突に巻き込まれるようなクエストを作ってみると面白いかもしれない。
blocks.translation: For example, it might be interesting to create a quest that the player is suddenly drawn into in the middle of an adventure.

blocks.source: ご褒美を用意する
blocks.translation: Prepare a Reward

blocks.source: 基本中の基本。
blocks.translation: The most basic principle.

blocks.source: ……なのだが、現実にはサブクエストの報酬が手間に見合わない作品はかなり多い。個人的には近年のＲＰＧをプレイしていて、強く不満を感じる部分である。
blocks.translation: …And yet, in reality, there are quite a lot of games whose side-quest rewards are not worth the effort. Personally, this is one aspect of modern RPGs that I find particularly frustrating when I play them.

blocks.source: 一時間かけて達成したクエストの報酬が、何に使うのかもよく分からない合成素材だった。
blocks.translation: The reward for a quest that took an hour to complete was a crafting material whose purpose was unclear.

blocks.source: 大金が手に入ったが、そもそも金に困っていない。
blocks.translation: I obtained a large sum of money, but I was not short on money in the first place.

blocks.source: 新しい仲間が加入したが、初期から加入した仲間のほうが強いので出番がない。
blocks.translation: A new companion joined the party, but they had no role because the companions who joined at the beginning were stronger.

blocks.source: ……なんてことはありがち。
blocks.translation: …Things like that are all too common.

blocks.source: 店や宝箱、ドロップアイテムなど普段から強力なアイテムが簡単に手に入るような作品なら、クエスト報酬のありがたみは薄くなる。そのためには、全体を通したバランス調整が必要だ。
blocks.translation: If powerful items are readily available through shops, chests, dropped items, and so on, quest rewards will feel less valuable. To avoid this, the game needs to be balanced as a whole.

blocks.source: また、お金を報酬に含めるのは基本だが、普段からお金に困らないようなバランスではありがたみは薄れる。既に足りているものをもらっても、大して嬉しくないからだ。
blocks.translation: Including money among the rewards is fundamental, but if the game is balanced so that you are never short on money, it will feel less valuable. Receiving something you already have enough of is not particularly exciting.

blocks.source: 新しい仲間の加入は報酬としても、とても魅力的だ。ただし、サブクエストで加入するキャラクターの本編での扱いは難しい。
blocks.translation: Recruiting new party members is also a very appealing reward. However, it is difficult to determine how characters who join through side quests should be handled in the main story.

blocks.source: ＰＳ版ＦＦ７のユフィ＆ヴィンセントのように、本編ではいない可能性を想定しなければならない。となると、大きく物語に絡ませることも難しい。
blocks.translation: As with Yuffie and Vincent in the PlayStation version of FF7, you have to account for the possibility that they may not be present in the main story. This makes it difficult to involve them heavily in the story.

blocks.source: 転職システムにおける職業のような要素があるならば、その解放は強い動機になるので積極的に活用していこう。
blocks.translation: If your game has elements such as the jobs in a job system, unlocking them can be a strong motivation, so make active use of them.

blocks.source: その他には、経験値やスキルポイントのような作品独自のポイントを報酬に含めてもよいだろう。
blocks.translation: You could also include game-specific points, such as experience points or skill points, among the rewards.

blocks.source: テンポを良くする
blocks.translation: Improve the Pacing

blocks.source: メインストーリーの腰を折りたくないならば、サブクエストはテンポを良くするように意識しておきたい。
blocks.translation: If you do not want to disrupt the main story, you should design side quests with good pacing in mind.

blocks.source: 具体的にはダンジョンは短く、イベントも長すぎないように。ボス戦も短期決戦にする。ノーヒントのアイテム探しのような辛いことはさせない。
blocks.translation: Specifically, keep dungeons short and events from becoming too long. Make boss battles short and decisive. Do not force players to endure tedious tasks such as searching for items without any hints.

blocks.source: 数を絞る
blocks.translation: Limit the Number

blocks.source: 質を高めるにはやはり数を絞ったほうがいい。
blocks.translation: To improve quality, it is better to limit the number.

blocks.source: 個人的にはかなりの大作でもメインストーリーがしっかりあるならば、サブクエストは１０～２０もあれば十分だと思う。
blocks.translation: Personally, I think that even a very large-scale game with a solid main story needs only 10–20 side quests.

blocks.source: 数を絞れば、メインストーリーの腰を折ったり、ゲームバランスを崩したりといった問題も軽減できる。
blocks.translation: Limiting the number can also reduce problems such as disrupting the main story or upsetting the game balance.

blocks.source: 複数種類の混在
blocks.translation: Combining Multiple Types

blocks.source: 前述したサブクエストの種類を組み合わせることで、それらの長所を活かしていく。
blocks.translation: By combining the types of side quests mentioned above, you can make use of their respective strengths.

blocks.source: 例えば、簡略型や自動生成型は単調なイベントになりやすく面白みは薄い。重要なイベントでないことはプレイヤーにも一目瞭然だが、それはある意味では長所にもなる。
blocks.translation: For example, streamlined and procedurally generated types tend to become monotonous events and are not very interesting. It is immediately obvious to players that they are not important events, but that can also be an advantage in a sense.

blocks.source: つまり「面倒ならやらなければいい」ということが分かりやすい。プレイヤーは自然と稼ぎなどの目的がある場合のみ取り組むようになるだろう。
blocks.translation: In other words, it is clear that players can simply choose not to do them if they find them troublesome. Players will naturally undertake them only when they have a purpose, such as grinding.

blocks.source: ミニゲーム
blocks.translation: Minigames

blocks.source: 寄り道要素といえばミニゲームの存在も忘れてはならない。
blocks.translation: When considering optional diversions, you must not forget about minigames.

blocks.source: カジノやすごろくなどのギャンブル系や、シューティングやレースなどのアクション系など色々と考えられる。長い物語の良いアクセントになるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Many possibilities come to mind, such as gambling games like casinos and sugoroku, or action games like shooters and racing games. They might provide a nice change of pace in a long story.

blocks.source: ただし、通常とは異なるゲーム性を強要されること自体をストレスに感じる人も多い。特にＲＰＧのプレイヤーはアクションを苦手とする傾向も強いはず。
blocks.translation: However, many people find it stressful simply to be forced to play something with different gameplay from the norm. RPG players in particular are likely to have a strong tendency to struggle with action games.

blocks.source: 当然ながら、ストーリーの腰も折りやすいだろう。
blocks.translation: Naturally, they can also easily disrupt the story.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１０はシリーズでも非常に評価の高い作品だが、最強武器の入手にミニゲーム（特に雷避け）が必要な仕様については不満の声が多く上がっていた。
blocks.translation: FF10 is highly regarded even within the series, but many players expressed dissatisfaction with the requirement to complete minigames—especially dodging lightning—in order to obtain the strongest weapons.

blocks.source: 個人的にはミニゲームは無理してまで取り入れる必要はないと思う。
blocks.translation: Personally, I do not think minigames need to be included at all costs.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 作品とサブクエストの相性は真っ先に考えておきたい。
blocks.translation: The compatibility between the game and its side quests should be considered first and foremost.

blocks.source: ストーリー重視を標榜しているのに、質の低いお使いクエストがたくさんあるようでは、高い評価を得られないだろう。
blocks.translation: Even if you claim to prioritize the story, you will not receive high praise if the game is filled with low-quality fetch quests.

blocks.source: 反対にゲーム性に優れた作品で、各クエストのご褒美も適切ならば、多少のお使いイベントも許容されるかもしれない。ゲームが面白いからストーリーはおまけというわけだ。
blocks.translation: Conversely, in a game with excellent gameplay, if the rewards for each quest are appropriate, players may tolerate a few fetch quests. In other words, the story is merely an extra because the game itself is fun.

blocks.source: サブクエストをあえて採用しないというのも立派な判断だ。
blocks.translation: Choosing not to include side quests at all can also be a perfectly valid decision.

blocks.source: 特にメインストーリー重視の作品ならば、安易なサブクエストの乱発は考えものだろう。
blocks.translation: Especially in a game that prioritizes its main story, carelessly flooding it with side quests is probably ill-advised.

texts.サブクエストとは、ゲームの本編（メインクエスト）とは別に攻略が必須ではない寄り道: A subquest is an optional side event separate from the main story (main quest) of a game.
texts.昨今のＲＰＧでは、大手メーカーの大作からインディーゲームまでサブクエストが当たり: In today's RPGs, subquests are commonplace, from major titles by large manufacturers to indie games.
texts.ＳＦＣの時代にはいくつかの寄り道要素がある程度の作品が大半だったが、今となっては: During the SFC era, most games had only a few side activities, but these days, games that do not use a subquest system may be the rare ones.
texts.そんなサブクエストについて、一度考察してみたい。: I would like to take a closer look at subquests.
texts.ここではサブクエストという呼称を使うが、寄り道要素全般を扱う。: I will use the term "subquest" here, but this discussion covers side activities in general.
texts.なお、以下の『自由度』に関する講座と内容は多少かぶっている。: The content also overlaps somewhat with the following guide on "Freedom of Choice."
texts.まずはサブクエストの種類を挙げてみたい。: First, I would like to list some types of subquests.
texts.どのようなサブクエストを採用するかによって、作品の雰囲気も変わってくるはずだ。: The atmosphere of a game should also change depending on the types of subquests it adopts.
texts.メインクエストとほぼ変わらない品質のイベント。: An event with quality almost on par with the main quest.
texts.導入から結末まで短編としてのストーリー性があるため、最も手間がかかる。: Because it has the story structure of a short story from beginning to end, it requires the most effort.
texts.個人的にはアークザラッド２が印象深い。: Personally, I remember Arc the Lad II particularly well.
texts.ボスを倒すことを目的としたイベント。: An event whose objective is to defeat a boss.
texts.基本的にストーリー性はほぼなく、ボス戦のみとなる。: It generally has little to no story and consists only of a boss battle.
texts.ボス戦までの流れを凝ったものにした場合は、標準型と変わらなくなる。: If the events leading up to the boss battle are elaborate, it becomes no different from the standard type.
texts.メタルマックスシリーズやＦＦシリーズなど数多くの作品で見かける。: This type can be found in many games, including the Metal Max and Final Fantasy series.
texts.標準型を大幅に簡略したもの。: A heavily simplified version of the standard type.
texts.依頼文と報告以外はほぼストーリー性がない。: Other than the request and the report, it has almost no story.
texts.「スライムを１０体倒せ」「薬草を５個持ってこい」のような内容が多く、いかにもなお: The objectives are often things like "Defeat 10 slimes" or "Bring me 5 medicinal herbs," making them quintessential fetch quests.
texts.依頼文の内容を頑張れば申し訳程度にストーリー性を出すこともできるが、さすがにこれ: Working hard on the request's wording can add a modest amount of story, but there are limits to how interesting this alone can be.
texts.内容的には簡略型に近いが、さらに内容をランダム生成したもの。: Similar in content to the simplified type, but with the content generated randomly as well.
texts.クリアしても終わらず、無限に引受けできる場合もある。: It may not end even after completion, allowing the player to accept quests indefinitely.
texts.ＡＩの発展に伴い、将来的にはもっと複雑なイベントが自動生成されるようになるかもし: As AI advances, increasingly complex events may be generated automatically in the future.
texts.戦闘に参加しないメンバーを派遣するイベント。: An event in which members who do not participate in battle are dispatched.
texts.ＦＦＴの儲け話やゼノブレイド２の傭兵団任務など。: Examples include FFT's propositions and the mercenary organization missions in Xenoblade Chronicles 2.
texts.一度派遣した後は、時間経過（日数経過、プレイ時間など）を待つだけで操作をすること: After dispatching them once, you simply wait for time to pass (days, play time, and so on), without taking any further action. In other words, it is an idle type.
texts.内容そのものは簡略型のような単純なものであることが多い。: The content itself is often simple, like that of the simplified type.
texts.サブクエストはその開始方法によっても個性付けができる。: Subquests can also be given distinctive character through the way they are started.
texts.作品内で統一するか、場合によって異なる開始方法を取ってもよい。: You can standardize the method throughout the game, or use different methods depending on the situation.
texts.ギルドなどサブクエスト用の施設で受注する。: The player accepts quests at a facility for subquests, such as a guild.
texts.開始方法が分かりやすく、見落としが発生しにくいのが利点だろう。: The advantage is that the way to start them is easy to understand, making them less likely to be overlooked.
texts.町の住民など依頼者から直接受注する。: The player accepts quests directly from requesters, such as town residents.
texts.依頼者を誰にするかによっても個性づけができる。: The requester can also give the quest a distinctive character.
texts.必ずしも依頼という形式を取る必要はない。: A quest does not necessarily have to take the form of a request.
texts.例えば、落とし穴から洞窟内に落下した後で「洞窟から脱出しよう」というようなクエス: For example, after the player falls through a pitfall into a cave, you could trigger a quest such as "Let's escape from the cave."
texts.メインクエストから派生: Branching Off from the Main Quest
texts.メインクエストの最中にサブクエストを発生させてもよい。: A subquest can arise during the main quest.
texts.例えば「ボスを倒すにはとある武器が有効だが、別になくても倒せる」というように必須: For example, you could create an optional quest where "a certain weapon is effective against the boss, but the boss can still be defeated without it."
texts.他にも、取り逃した敵キャラの行方を追う寄り道クエストなんていうのはどうだろうか。: Another possibility would be a side quest to track down an enemy the player missed.
texts.ゲーム制作者はどのような狙いでサブクエストを制作するのか？ 利点を考えてみよう。: What goals do game developers have when creating side quests? Let’s consider their advantages.
texts.攻略自由度の増加: Greater Freedom in How to Progress
texts.サブクエストは進行するタイミングなどの自由度が高い。: Side quests offer considerable freedom in when and how to progress through them.
texts.それによって、ゲーム性を向上させる効果がある。: This can improve the gameplay experience.
texts.例えば、あるクエストで手に入れた武器が、別のクエストのボスの弱点だったりすれば、: For example, if a weapon obtained from one quest is the weakness of a boss in another quest, players have room to devise their own strategies.
texts.プレイヤーはサブクエストのやるやらないを選択することができる。: Players can choose whether or not to take on side quests.
texts.つまり「面倒ならやらなければいい」というわけだ。: In other words, “if it seems like a hassle, you don’t have to do it.”
texts.重要でないクエストをサブに回すことで、プレイヤーは理想のテンポでゲームを進めるこ: By making less important quests optional, players can progress through the game at their ideal pace.
texts.サブクエストを活用すれば、メインクエストでは描ききれなかった部分を補完できる。: Side quests can be used to fill in parts that could not be fully depicted in the main quests.
texts.プレイヤーに強制するほどではないイベントは、サブクエストとして実装すればよいだろ: Events that are not important enough to force on the player can be implemented as side quests.
texts.経験値稼ぎの代替: An Alternative to Grinding for Experience
texts.古典的な経験値稼ぎの代わりの手段として、サブクエストを活用する方法。: Side quests can serve as an alternative to the classic method of grinding for experience.
texts.経験値稼ぎは同じことの繰り返しになりやすく、飽きられやすい。サブクエストという形: Grinding for experience tends to involve repeating the same actions and can quickly become tiresome. Using side quests can alleviate that monotony.
texts.『簡略型』や『自動生成型』と組み合わせるのもよいかもしれない。: It may also be a good idea to combine them with simplified or procedurally generated content.
texts.本編だけだとすぐに終わってしまって物足りない――なんて作品はサブクエストによって: If a game feels too short and unsatisfying when played with only the main story, side quests can be used to pad out its content.
texts.本編に継ぎ足すよりは、独立したプロットでイベントを作成できるため、比較的に作りや: Unlike adding to the main story, events can be created from independent plots, which has the advantage of making them relatively easy to develop.
texts.奥深いシステムや豊富なスキルを作ったのに、それを活かすだけの本編の規模がない――: They may be useful when you have created deep systems and a wealth of skills, but the main story is not large enough to make full use of them.
texts.なお、水増しという言葉は一般的にネガティブな意味で使われることが多い。当然、デメ: Incidentally, the term “padding” is generally used in a negative sense. Naturally, there are disadvantages as well, which I will discuss later.
texts.サブクエストにはそれなりに大きな欠点がある。: Side quests have some fairly significant disadvantages.
texts.そのため、流行だからといって思考停止で導入することはオススメしない。: For that reason, I do not recommend adding them thoughtlessly just because they are popular.
texts.以下に欠点をまとめてみた。: I have summarized their disadvantages below.
texts.当然ながら、メインストーリーに切迫感がある作品と寄り道要素は相性が悪い。: Naturally, detours do not work well in games whose main stories have a strong sense of urgency.
texts.「人質の命が危ない、一刻も早く助けないと！」とか「このままではあと二週間で世界が: If the situation is something like “The hostage’s life is in danger—we have to rescue them as soon as possible!”, “The world will collapse in two weeks if this continues!”, or “The heroine has only one month left to live!”, then spending all your time on detours creates an overwhelming sense of incongruity.
texts.こういった設定をせざるを得ないにしても、明確かつ短い期間は出さないほうが無難だろ: Even if you have no choice but to establish this kind of premise, it is probably safer not to specify a clear, short time limit.
texts.メインストーリーでグイグイ引っ張るタイプの作品は、サブクエストと相性が悪い。: Games that strongly drive the player forward through their main stories do not pair well with side quests.
texts.「次の展開を見たい！」とプレイヤーに強く思わせても、それをサブクエストが挟まるこ: Even if players are eager to see what happens next, inserting side quests can completely disrupt that momentum.
texts.１～２時間かけてサブクエストをやっているうちに、熱が冷めてしまったり、話を忘れて: After spending one or two hours on side quests, players may lose interest or even forget what was happening in the story.
texts.これは非常に大きな欠点であり、決して無視はできない。: This is a very significant disadvantage and cannot be ignored.
texts.ならば、「面倒ならやらなければいい」と思うかもしれないが、これもそう簡単な話では: You might think, “If it seems like a hassle, just don’t do it,” but the matter is not that simple.

texts.サブクエストの利点として任意性――つまり「面倒ならやらなければいい」ということを: I previously mentioned optionality as an advantage of side quests—in other words, “if it seems like a hassle, you don’t have to do it.” However, this does not always hold true.

texts.そういった不利益を嫌うならば、プレイヤーは多少つまらなそうなサブクエストでも我慢: If players want to avoid such disadvantages, they may end up having to force themselves to complete side quests that seem somewhat boring.

texts.そんなわけで、質より量を優先してサブクエストで内容を水増しすることは、個人的には: For these reasons, I personally take a negative view of padding out content with side quests by prioritizing quantity over quality.

texts.そして、長ったるい作品は時間を無駄にしたと感じるため、次回作があったとしても手を: Also, because overly long games make you feel that you wasted your time, you may lose interest in playing their sequels, even if they exist.
texts.特にストーリーのつながった続編にとっては致命的だ。クリアを諦めたＲＰＧの続編に手: This is particularly fatal for sequels with a connected story. Very few people would play the sequel to an RPG they gave up on finishing, except perhaps the most devoted fans.

texts.サブクエストをこなすかどうかによって、プレイヤーの強さは変化する。サブクエストの: The player’s strength changes depending on whether they complete side quests. The more substantial the side-quest rewards, the greater the change in strength.

texts.サブクエストをプレイヤーが一切やらない前提で調整するにしても、ある程度のクリアを: Whether you balance the game on the assumption that players will not do any side quests at all or that they will complete a certain number of them, it will be difficult to set a difficulty level that satisfies everyone.

texts.結局のところ、サブクエストがプレイヤーを夢中にさせるほどに面白ければ、全ては許さ: Ultimately, if side quests are interesting enough to engross players, everything else can be forgiven.
texts.というわけで、サブクエストを面白くする方法を考えてみたい。: With that in mind, I would like to consider ways to make side quests interesting.

texts.例によって、無理に全てを採用する必要はないので、取捨選択をして欲しい。: As usual, you do not need to adopt everything indiscriminately, so I encourage you to choose what works best.
texts.サブクエストの利点として『ストーリーの補完』を挙げた通り、サブクエストは本編とも: As I mentioned when discussing “supplementing the story” as an advantage of side quests, I would like to actively tie side quests into the main story as well.
texts.例えば、主人公や仲間を初めとして、本編で登場したキャラクターを掘り下げるようなイ: For example, try creating events that delve deeper into characters who appeared in the main story, including the protagonist and their companions.
texts.ポッと出のモブキャラに頼まれたお使いイベントを面白くすることは難しいので、積極的: It is difficult to make a fetch quest requested by a newly introduced minor character interesting, so I would like to rely actively on the appeal of established characters.
texts.そういった意味では、サブクエストはいわゆるキャラゲーにも向いている。: In that sense, side quests are also well suited to so-called character-driven games.
texts.仲間の掘り下げイベント。: Events that delve deeper into the companions.

texts.のようなイベントが考えられる。: Events such as these could be considered.

texts.このようにすれば、複数のクエストによって単なる短編には留まらない大がかりなストー: In this way, multiple quests can be used to tell a large-scale story that goes beyond being merely a short episode.
texts.依頼主などの登場人物を印象づけやすいことも利点となるだろう。: Another advantage is that it becomes easier to make characters such as the clients memorable.

texts.もちろん、仲間との楽しい会話も忘れずに。: Of course, do not forget to include fun conversations with the companions.
texts.最もありきたりなサブクエストの形式は、誰か（特にギルドなど）から依頼を受けるよう: The most commonplace type of side quest is probably one in which you receive a request from someone, especially a guild.
texts.例えば、冒険の途中で唐突に巻き込まれるようなクエストを作ってみると面白いかもしれ: For example, it might be interesting to create a quest that the player is suddenly drawn into in the middle of an adventure.
texts.……なのだが、現実にはサブクエストの報酬が手間に見合わない作品はかなり多い。個人: …And yet, in reality, there are quite a lot of games whose side-quest rewards are not worth the effort. Personally, this is one aspect of modern RPGs that I find particularly frustrating when I play them.

texts.大金が手に入ったが、そもそも金に困っていない。: I obtained a large sum of money, but I was not short on money in the first place.

texts.……なんてことはありがち。: …Things like that are all too common.
texts.店や宝箱、ドロップアイテムなど普段から強力なアイテムが簡単に手に入るような作品な: If powerful items are readily available through shops, chests, dropped items, and so on, quest rewards will feel less valuable. To avoid this, the game needs to be balanced as a whole.
texts.また、お金を報酬に含めるのは基本だが、普段からお金に困らないようなバランスではあ: Including money among the rewards is fundamental, but if the game is balanced so that you are never short on money, it will feel less valuable. Receiving something you already have enough of is not particularly exciting.
texts.新しい仲間の加入は報酬としても、とても魅力的だ。ただし、サブクエストで加入するキ: Recruiting new party members is also a very appealing reward. However, it is difficult to determine how characters who join through side quests should be handled in the main story.

texts.転職システムにおける職業のような要素があるならば、その解放は強い動機になるので積: If your game has elements such as the jobs in a job system, unlocking them can be a strong motivation, so make active use of them.
texts.その他には、経験値やスキルポイントのような作品独自のポイントを報酬に含めてもよい: You could also include game-specific points, such as experience points or skill points, among the rewards.

texts.カジノやすごろくなどのギャンブル系や、シューティングやレースなどのアクション系な: Many possibilities come to mind, such as gambling games like casinos and sugoroku, or action games like shooters and racing games. They might provide a nice change of pace in a long story.
texts.ただし、通常とは異なるゲーム性を強要されること自体をストレスに感じる人も多い。特: However, many people find it stressful simply to be forced to play something with different gameplay from the norm. RPG players in particular are likely to have a strong tendency to struggle with action games.

texts.ストーリー重視を標榜しているのに、質の低いお使いクエストがたくさんあるようでは、: Even if you claim to prioritize the story, you will not receive high praise if the game is filled with low-quality fetch quests.
texts.反対にゲーム性に優れた作品で、各クエストのご褒美も適切ならば、多少のお使いイベン: Conversely, in a game with excellent gameplay, if the rewards for each quest are appropriate, players may tolerate a few fetch quests. In other words, the story is merely an extra because the game itself is fun.
texts.サブクエストをあえて採用しないというのも立派な判断だ。: Choosing not to include side quests at all can also be a perfectly valid decision.
